title: Classify pH/EC freshness, missing, stale, and conflict inputs for advisor behavior

gates.name: advisor input classification tests
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/advisory backend/tests/runtime_state backend/tests/plant_operations backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security

verify: Missing pH or EC creates unknown/missing behavior and clarify or measurement request handoff.
Stale pH/EC can support cautious historical analysis only when labeled stale and cannot support physical-action wording.
Conflicting pH/EC or observation evidence creates conflict with refs and asks for re-check or follow-up.
evidence_required: VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
constraints: pH/EC analysis freshness follows Safety Gate default up to 24 hours unless later spec narrows it.
pH/EC physical-action approval freshness follows Safety Gate default up to 2 hours, but FT-011 only routes and does not approve.
Fresh data is required but never sufficient by itself for physical action.
invariants: pH/EC provenance and freshness must follow owning runtime/state/safety specs.
Stale, missing, conflicting, unauthorized, or untrusted evidence fails closed or routes to missing-data/check/measurement behavior.
